en.mapviz.pictures.title: Map pictures
en.mapviz.pictures.tickLayer: Tick the Map picture layer to see it.
en.mapviz.pictures.noSave: This browser cannot save files here.
en.mapviz.pictures.notMadeSave: Make the picture first, then save it.
en.mapviz.pictures.makeT: Make this picture. A large map can take some minutes.
en.mapviz.pictures.noMap: Open a map to see its pictures.
en.mapviz.pictures.bright: Brightness not checked against the game yet.
en.mapviz.pictures.gapOther: Another gap (point at it for its code).
en.mapviz.pictures.notesMore: {n} more notes (point at it to read them).
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MATERIAL_MISS: Some ground materials were not found; those parts are drawn flat.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MATERIAL_BAD: Some ground materials could not be read; those parts are drawn flat.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_TEXTURE_MISSI: Some ground textures were not found; those parts are drawn flat.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_TEXTURE_BAD: Some ground textures could not be read; those parts are drawn flat.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_LAYERS_SHORT: Some ground layers are missing; the ground has fewer layers.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_VCOLOR: The ground has no vertex colours; it is drawn without them.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GLOBAL_MISSIN: The map's overall ground texture was not found.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GLOBAL_NORMAL: The map's overall surface relief texture is not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_UNCOVERED: The ground has holes; the picture leaves them empty.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_SHADE: No shaded relief was found; the picture is drawn flat.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_SIZE: Some decals have no size and are not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_TEXTURE: Some decal textures are missing; those decals are not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_WATER_PLANE: Some water surfaces could not be loaded and are not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_WATER_APPROX: The sea is drawn as a flat plane: approximate.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_BASE_REDRAWN: The ground picture under the objects was on another frame and is drawn again.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MODEL_MISSING: Some object models were not found and are not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MODEL_BAD: Some object models could not be read and are not drawn.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_OBJ_TEXTURE: Some object textures are missing; those objects are drawn grey.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_PART_UNPLACED: Some object parts have no place on the map and are left out.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_GROUND: Some objects have no ground height under them and are drawn at height 0.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_BAD_POSITION: Some objects have a broken position and are left out.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_INPUT_ABSENT: Some map data could not be read or made, so it is missing from the picture.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_DROWN_VEHICLE_: Deep water is drawn where a ground vehicle drowns.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_TEXMOD_MISSIN: Some texture variants were not found; the default texture is used.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_LIGHTMAP_MISS: Some light maps could not be read; objects are drawn without them.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_ENV_MISSING: The mode's light was not found; clean daylight is used.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_ENV_PLACEHOLD: The mode's light is an empty placeholder; clean daylight is used.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GRASS_MISSING: The grass file was not found; no grass tint.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GRASS_BAD: The grass file could not be read; no grass tint.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_WATER_MASKS: No water layers; water is drawn from the ground types only.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_OBJECTS: No object list; trees and buildings are left out.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_LANDFORM: No landform layer; ridges and hollows are left out.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_SCHEMATIC: Made from the schematic picture: no realistic picture was there.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_MINIMAP: Made from the map's own minimap.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_APPROX: Made from an approximate realistic picture.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_MATERIAL: Some ground materials are unknown; a plain fill is used.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_UNREAD: A base picture could not be read; the next one was used.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_INPUT_MADE: Some layers were made while drawing.
en.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_MARKS_DROPPED: Some marks did not fit and were left out.
en.mapviz.pictures.badWhole: The {side} must be a whole number of pixels, not {v}.
en.mapviz.pictures.badSmall: The {side} must be at least {n} pixels.
en.mapviz.pictures.badBig: The {side} must be at most {n} pixels.
en.mapviz.pictures.keepLast: The last good size stays in use until this is fixed.
en.mapviz.pictures.noUse: The open map does not list this game use yet.
en.mapviz.pictures.noBox: The map has no world box yet, so the size cannot be matched to it.
en.mapviz.pictures.keepT: Fill the other side from the map's width to height
en.mapviz.pictures.shapeSame: {w} x {h} has the map's shape: the whole map fills it (made at {L} px on the long side).
en.mapviz.pictures.shape.stretch: {w} x {h} (shape {size}) is not the map's shape ({map}): the whole map is stretched to fill it.
en.mapviz.pictures.shape.backdrop: {w} x {h} (shape {size}) is not the map's shape ({map}): the whole map keeps its shape, centred over a blurred, darker copy that shows as bars.
en.mapviz.pictures.shape.crop: {w} x {h} (shape {size}) is not the map's shape ({map}): the middle of the map fills it and the edges are cut off.

ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_VCOLOR: У земли нет цветов вершин; она нарисована без них.

ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_SIZE: У некоторых декалей нет размера; они не нарисованы.
ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_TEXTURE: Нет некоторых текстур декалей; эти декали не нарисованы.
ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_WATER_PLANE: Некоторые поверхности воды не загрузились и не нарисованы.

ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_MATERIAL: Некоторые материалы земли неизвестны; взята простая заливка.
ru.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_INPUT_MADE: Некоторые слои сделаны во время рисования.

ru.mapviz.pictures.badSmall: Значение «{side}» должно быть не меньше {n} пикселей.
ru.mapviz.pictures.badBig: Значение «{side}» должно быть не больше {n} пикселей.

ru.mapviz.pictures.noUse: Открытая карта пока не называет такое использование в игре.
ru.mapviz.pictures.noBox: У карты ещё нет рамки мира, поэтому размер нельзя подогнать под неё.

ru.mapviz.pictures.shape.backdrop: {w} x {h} (форма {size}) не совпадает с формой карты ({map}): карта сохраняет форму и стоит по центру над размытой затемнённой копией, видной как полосы.

zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GLOBAL_MISSIN: 未找到地图的整体地面纹理。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GLOBAL_NORMAL: 未绘制地图的整体表面起伏纹理。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_UNCOVERED: 地面有空洞；图片中这些地方留空。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_SHADE: 未找到地形晕渲；图片以平面绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_SIZE: 部分贴花没有尺寸，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_DECAL_TEXTURE: 缺少部分贴花纹理；这些贴花未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_WATER_PLANE: 部分水面无法加载，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_BASE_REDRAWN: 物体下方的地面图位于另一画框，已重新绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MODEL_MISSING: 部分物体模型未找到，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_MODEL_BAD: 部分物体模型无法读取，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_OBJ_TEXTURE: 缺少部分物体纹理；这些物体以灰色绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_PART_UNPLACED: 部分物体部件在地图上没有位置，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_NO_GROUND: 部分物体下方没有地面高度，按高度 0 绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_BAD_POSITION: 部分物体的位置有误，未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_INPUT_ABSENT: 部分地图数据无法读取或生成，所以图片中缺少这些内容。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_DROWN_VEHICLE_: 深水按地面车辆会淹没的位置绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_TEXMOD_MISSIN: 部分纹理变体未找到；使用默认纹理。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_LIGHTMAP_MISS: 部分光照贴图无法读取；物体绘制时不含光照贴图。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_ENV_MISSING: 未找到该模式的光照；使用纯净日光。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_ENV_PLACEHOLD: 该模式的光照是空占位；使用纯净日光。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GRASS_MISSING: 未找到草地文件；不加草地色调。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.RENDER_GRASS_BAD: 草地文件无法读取；不加草地色调。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_WATER_MASKS: 没有水域图层；水面只按地面类型绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_OBJECTS: 没有物体列表；树木和建筑未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_LANDFORM: 没有地貌图层；山脊和洼地未绘制。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_SCHEMATIC: 以示意图为底图生成：没有写实图片。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_MINIMAP: 以地图自带的小地图为底图生成。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_APPROX: 以近似的写实图片为底图生成。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_NO_MATERIAL: 部分地面材质未知；使用纯色填充。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_BASE_UNREAD: 一张底图无法读取；改用下一张。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_INPUT_MADE: 部分图层在绘制时生成。
zh.mapviz.pictures.gap.PAINT_MARKS_DROPPED: 部分标记放不下，已省略。
zh.mapviz.pictures.keepLast: 在修正之前，仍使用上一个有效尺寸。
zh.mapviz.pictures.noUse: 打开的地图尚未列出这一游戏用途。
zh.mapviz.pictures.noBox: 地图还没有世界范围框，因此无法按它匹配尺寸。
zh.mapviz.pictures.keepT: 按地图的宽高比算出另一边
zh.mapviz.pictures.shapeSame: {w} x {h} 与地图形状一致：整张地图填满图片（按长边 {L} 像素制作）。
zh.mapviz.pictures.shape.stretch: {w} x {h}（比例 {size}）与地图形状（{map}）不同：整张地图被拉伸填满。
zh.mapviz.pictures.shape.backdrop: {w} x {h}（比例 {size}）与地图形状（{map}）不同：整张地图保持原形状居中，下面是模糊变暗的副本，显示为边条。
zh.mapviz.pictures.shape.crop: {w} x {h}（比例 {size}）与地图形状（{map}）不同：用地图的中间部分填满，边缘被裁掉。
